destination.name: Portland
destination.tagline: Victoria's oldest European settlement, with whaling history and seal-filled capes.
destination.description: Portland, on Portland Bay, is the oldest European settlement in Victoria: Edward Henty landed in November 1834 and sowed the state's first wheat crop. It has more than 200 historical buildings from the 1800s and a working waterfront where the fishing fleet lands its catch. The 251 km Great South West Walk starts and ends at the Portland Visitor Information Centre.
whyVisit: Walk forest, gorge and clifftop tracks
See fur seals and whales from clifftops

goodToKnow.title: Whale season
goodToKnow.detail: Southern right whales pass Cape Bridgewater in winter and spring, and often visit Portland Bay in winter.

goodToKnow.title: Day-walk the big track
goodToKnow.detail: The 251 km Great South West Walk has shorter sections, reached from roads near Portland and Nelson.
